# Brand development — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Build a brand from category research through strategy, naming with preliminary IP screening, identity concepts and a production brandbook, with originality review and human approval before any public use.

**Trigger:** A company, product or feature needs a brand, name or identity.
